more_info.overview: Magnesium sulphate is an inorganic magnesium salt commonly supplied in a hydrated form. The heptahydrate also occurs naturally as the mineral epsomite. FDA describes commercial preparation by reacting magnesium oxide, hydroxide or carbonate with sulphuric acid and crystallising the solution. Its listed food functions include nutrient supplementation, flavour enhancement and processing assistance.
more_info.origin: Manufactured by neutralising magnesium oxide, hydroxide or carbonate with sulphuric acid, then evaporating the solution to crystallise the salt. Magnesium sulphate also occurs naturally as epsomite. The described food-grade route is chemical preparation of an inorganic mineral salt.
